verdicts.rationale: On chart pages that contain axis tick numbers, has_numeric_columns fires and causes arbitration to route them as table pages. The table verifier then grades model outputs against the native text layer (which is only axis numbers), rejecting all rungs for row-count mismatch and shipping the raw axis dump as native fallback. Abstaining from table scoring when native text does not form a grid (table_not_scorable) or routing chart tick pages to chart_asset resolves this in one night.
